name: iter_pool_and_target
description: Two loop-only ablations crossed. (1) POOL MODE: a fresh candidate pool every round (the paper's protocol) versus a single fixed pool consumed without replacement — the latter is the fixed-dataset industrial setting the study is motivated by, where guidance eventually exhausts the good candidates. (2) DETECT MODE: re-identify the weakspot against the current model each round versus pinning the first detection — separating the value of *tracking* a migrating weakness from the value of aiming at it once. Also sweeps the initial-training time, since the paper's cold-start finding (intervene while undertrained) may not survive repetition. Accumulative regime, 8 iterations, one detector, 10 seeds.
